informal_statement: For arbitrary sets \(A,B,C,D\), the pairwise-overlap set is the union of all six intersections \(A\cap B\), \(A\cap C\), \(A\cap D\), \(B\cap C\), \(B\cap D\), and \(C\cap D\).
